title: Agent bridge and window control
summary: Window side of the agent protocol: AgentBridge long-polls the engine and runs MCP tools; UiControl lets an agent drive any form app (ui.inspect, ui.state, ui.screenshot, ui.menu.*); runScript is a no-network script sandbox.
description: The engine queues window tools; `AgentBridge` (in `agent-bridge.ts`) loops on `/api/mcp/bridge/next`, executes with the engine and posts results; hand edits are reported back (debounced 400 ms) through `/api/mcp/bridge/changed` so subscribed sessions are told. `UiControl` drives the app through the same elements and commands a person uses, including menus (`menuList`, `menuInvoke`, resolved from `MenuDef[]` of `ui.menu-glass`) and synthetic pointer/key input. `runScript` runs a script as an async function body in a worker whose fetch, WebSocket, storage and DOM names are removed; its only doors are `run(id, params)`, `commands()` and `log()`. `agent-bridge.ts` is 1.4k lines and imports most of formvis (engine, io, tools); the protocol and the ui-control/script-sandbox files are the reusable parts.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.signature: export interface McpResult { content: Array<{ type: 'text'; text: string } | { type: 'image'; data: string; mimeType: string }>; structuredContent?: Record<string, unknown>; isError?: boolean }
exports.doc: Outside agents in the window (1.52.1): while Allow outside agents is on (Preferences > Plugins), the window collects MCP tool calls from the engine and runs them here, each change an ordinary undoable step.

What the app hands the bridge: consent hooks ask, note and allow, plus optional app abilities (openFile, projectBlob, applyFilter, selectSubject, removeBackground, renderVideo, viewCapture, selectPoints, plugins and more).
The window side of the MCP bridge: loops on the engine bridge, runs each queued tool against the engine and posts results; hand edits are reported back (debounced 400 ms).
Turns the bridge loop on or off; turning it off stops waiting calls at once.

exports.signature: async run(name: string, a: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<McpResult>
exports.doc: One tool call; its MCP result.

exports.signature: export interface UiEnv { engine: Engine; commands: Commands; menus(): MenuDef[]; capture(): HTMLCanvasElement | null; docPoint(clientX: number, clientY: number): { x: number; y: number } | null; }
exports.doc: The window's own controls for outside agents: its state, a picture of a part of it, the menus by path, named settings, open dialogs, synthetic pointer and key input, and the window itself.
Window control by elements and commands a person uses: inspect, state, screenshots, menus, settings, dialogs, synthetic pointer and key input.
Snapshot as an McpResult: tool, document, view, colours, window size, theme, open dialogs, menu open, busy and fps.

exports.signature: async screenshot(selector: string, maxSize: number, jpeg: boolean, quality: number): Promise<McpResult>
exports.doc: A picture of the stage canvas, or of the part of the window a selector names, drawn from a copy of its elements.
Each command id in the menu bar with its path ("Filter > Blur > Gaussian Blur"); the first place a command appears.
Lists the menu tree at a path to a depth.

exports.signature: menuId(path: string): { id?: string; error?: string }
exports.doc: The command id a menu path names, or why not.

exports.signature: async menuInvoke(path: string, params: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): Promise<McpResult>
exports.doc: Runs the command a menu path names, with params.

exports.signature: export interface ScriptRun { ok: boolean; result?: unknown; log: string[]; error?: string }
exports.doc: Outcome of a script: ok, result, log lines and error.

exports.signature: export interface ScriptDeps { run(id: string, params: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown>; list(): Array<{ id: string; label: string }>; timeoutMs?: number; }
exports.doc: What the host supplies: run(id, params) for one catalogue command, list() of ids and labels, and an optional timeoutMs.

exports.signature: export function runScript(source: string, deps: ScriptDeps): Promise<ScriptRun>
exports.doc: Runs script source as an async function body in a dedicated worker with no network, storage or DOM.

invariants.text: Scripts run in a worker with fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, storage, navigator and location removed; the only doors out are run, commands and log.
Turning the bridge off tells the engine to stop waiting calls immediately.
A call from an agent is announced by the engine; hand edits are reported separately and debounced.
